title: Replace Paperclip with the in-repository task tracker
body: Per ADR 0014 D8, replace Paperclip, the legacy Git-ref task queue, and host-SQLite krn work with the Git-backed in-repository krn task tracker. This PR makes PR preflight read its delivery ticket from the committed tasks/<id>.json record; Paperclip records remain untouched and are not imported.
Remaining steps from decision.md: implement ready and claim, forward GLOBAL's krn task command, remove the legacy queue and krn work, then remove Paperclip from Product and GLOBAL.
